Stylized 3D cartoon animation in the style of the Royal Match mobile game cinematic, Pixar-like, soft low-contrast daylight, clean saturated colors, cozy fantasy wooded foothills. The character is a cute chibi child-sized cyclops: mint-green skin, a single large central eye (cyclops, only one eye), small horn, messy dark hair, pointy ears, beige linen tunic, brown satchel.
